WITH scoped AS (
 SELECT f.*,o.raw_order_json::jsonb AS raw_order FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o
 ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
 AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
 WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
), parsed AS (
 SELECT *,coalesce(raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'count_fp',raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'count',raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'quantity')::numeric AS q,
 (raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'fee_cost')::numeric AS actual_fee FROM scoped
), audit AS (
 SELECT *,trunc(q)+CASE WHEN q-trunc(q)>0.5 THEN 1 WHEN q-trunc(q)<0.5 THEN 0 ELSE mod(trunc(q),2) END AS rounded_even FROM parsed
)
SELECT count(*) AS fills,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE q<>quantity) AS quantity_mismatches,
count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FILTER(WHERE q<>quantity) AS mismatch_markets,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE q<>quantity AND quantity=rounded_even AND q>0) AS explained_by_positive_fractional_rounding,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE quantity<=0) AS stored_zero_or_negative,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE actual_fee IS NULL OR actual_fee<0) AS actual_fee_missing_or_negative,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'trade_id')=kalshi_fill_id) AS raw_fill_identity_match,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE raw_order->>'outcome_side'=raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'outcome_side' AND raw_order->>'book_side'=raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'book_side') AS canonical_direction_match
FROM audit
